notes.title: Welcome our new horror game!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

Besides working on anime games, I have something else in store for you. I'd like to introduce you to our new horror game in a Christmas setting. Watch the video, tell me your impression of the game, and don't forget to add it to your wishlist if you liked it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741420/
